item.title: [github_trending] nodejs/node
item.description: Node.js is a JavaScript runtime built on Chrome's V8 engine, allowing developers to write server-side code in JavaScript. Its event-driven, non-blocking I/O model makes it lightweight and efficient, ideal for building high-performance network applications and real-time systems. With its vast NPM ecosystem and cross-platform support, Node.js has become an essential foundation for modern full-stack development, powering everything from web servers to command-line tools and microservices.

item.title: [github_trending] OpenCut-app/OpenCut
item.description: OpenCut is an open-source video editor designed as a free alternative to CapCut. It offers powerful editing features without any subscription or watermark, making it ideal for content creators who want full control over their tools. The project is cross-platform and community-driven, ensuring transparency and continuous improvement. For anyone tired of paid video editors or restrictive platforms, OpenCut provides a flexible and privacy-respecting solution.

Its focus on simplicity and performance makes it a go-to choice for indie games and embedded tools.

Designed for analysts, journalists, and business leaders, it enables rapid situational awareness and informed decision-making by consolidating diverse data streams into an accessible interface. Its significance lies in simplifying complex global monitoring and helping professionals stay ahead of critical developments.

For anyone who has ever been annoyed by the endless stream of cookie notifications, this tool is a welcome relief.

item.title: [zhihu] 苏联在 60～80 年代为什么没有开发战机黑手党式的狗斗机？
item.description: The Soviet Union did not develop a dedicated dogfighter akin to the Western 'fighter mafia' concept in the 1960s-1980s due to differing air combat doctrines. Soviet strategy emphasized beyond-visual-range interception and missile attacks, aiming to avoid close-range engagements altogether. Additionally, their aviation industry lacked lightweight, high-thrust-to-weight engines and focused on heavy, high-speed interceptors like the MiG-25, which were poorly suited for low-speed turning dogfights.

This reveals the supply chain risk of relying on a few memory makers, and puts enormous pressure on ordinary PC builders and gamers. Industry insiders warn that if memory stays high, GPU prices are unlikely to drop anytime soon.

item.description: Moonshot AI released the Kimi K3-256K large language model, which retains the same core capabilities as the original K3 but reduces the context window to 256K tokens and removes video processing support. This appears to be a cost-performance trade-off, offering a leaner alternative for users who need long-context handling but not multimodal video features.
